data.title: The note taped to the exit door
data.goal: The note taped to the exit door

memoryNodes.cue: A missing part delays the work.
Maya records when to check again.

data.situation:
The trolley demonstration had a new note by the time Jo and Maya reached the exit. Repairs would take longer than the attendant had hoped. A missing replacement part was holding back the work. The note said that installation would follow delivery of the replacement part. Jo looked from the note to the darkened screen and understood why the display could not restart that morning. Maya added the closure to her notebook so that a friend would not make a special trip for that one demonstration. The rest of the gallery remained open, and the guide suggested returning when the notice had been updated. Jo: Is the whole gallery closed?
Guide: No, only this demonstration.
Maya: What is holding back the repair?
Guide: We are waiting for the replacement part. The notice will change when it is ready.

readingBlocks.zh: 乔和玛雅到出口时，小车演示旁多了一张便条。维修比工作人员原先希望的更久。缺少替换部件拖慢了工作。便条说替换部件送到后会安装。乔看着便条和黑下来的屏幕，明白演示为什么当日上午不能重启。玛雅把关闭情况记进笔记，免得朋友专为这一场演示白跑。馆内其余地方仍开放，讲解员建议等通知更新再来。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：全馆关闭了吗？
讲解员：不是，只有这场演示。
玛雅：什么拖慢维修？
